title: Bringing Joy Into Technology Learning for Older Adults
summary: An IDSA conversation puts enjoyment, everyday routines, and collaboration at the heart of technology learning for older adults.

paragraphs.text: Learning technology should make room for joy. That was the focus of Chorong Park's contribution to the IDSA design community, which she shared in a September 22, 2025, reflection on the previous week's conversations.

Park connected the topic to a practical goal: bringing designers and researchers together to create tools that fit real routines. She thanked participants for sharing what works in practice, especially where user experience meets industrial design.
AI, robotics, and human-computer interaction were part of that discussion. Rather than starting with what a new tool can do, her focus was on the experience of learning to use it.

The useful shift in perspective is simple: ease of use and enjoyment deserve attention together. Park's emphasis on joy invites designers to think beyond completing a task to how the learning experience feels.
